description: Emoncms is OpenEnergyMonitor's web application for processing, recording and visualising electricity, temperature and other environmental measurements. Incoming values pass through configurable processing lists into time-series feeds, with support for daily energy calculations, averages, graphs and CSV export. Inputs are measurement streams; outputs are stored and transformed series and visual summaries. Coverage is the user's monitored devices and period, with fixed or variable time intervals. Source is free under AGPL-3.0 and can be self-hosted with PHP, a database and a web server. A limitation is that some processors require Redis and can fail silently when it is absent. Hosting, sensors and service subscriptions are separate from the source licence. Emoncms can prepare measured building and energy demand for simulation calibration. PowerCalc (model-powercalc) supplies related estimated appliance loads. No hosted account, sensor feed or installation was accessed.
name: Emoncms energy time-series processing
